short_description.en: Official UIDAI guidance for requesting an address update through the MyAadhaar portal.

sources.title: Enrolment & Update: myAadhaar - Online Update Service FAQ

requirements.text: Your mobile number must already be registered with Aadhaar to use the online service and receive the login OTP.
You need your Aadhaar number to log in to the MyAadhaar portal.

required_documents.name: Valid proof of address
required_documents.guidance: Use a proof-of-address document accepted by UIDAI. The document should be in the Aadhaar holder's name, the entered address should match it, and the uploaded scan should be clear and in colour.

fee.display_message: Fee needs confirmation because UIDAI's official pages currently show different amounts for this service.

claims.qualifier: The online address-update FAQ states this amount, including GST.
The My Aadhaar service entry displays this amount for address update.

fee.resolution_guidance: UIDAI's official pages currently show different amounts for this service. Confirm the fee on the official portal before payment.

steps.title: Open the official MyAadhaar portal
steps.instruction: Continue from Sahayi to the official MyAadhaar website. Sahayi does not collect your Aadhaar number or submit the request.

steps.title: Log in on MyAadhaar
steps.instruction: On the official portal, use your Aadhaar number and the OTP sent to your registered mobile number.

steps.title: Enter the new address
steps.instruction: Enter the address requested by the official service and make sure it matches the proof-of-address document.

steps.title: Upload proof of address
steps.instruction: Upload a clear colour scan or image of an accepted proof-of-address document on the official portal.

steps.title: Pay and submit on MyAadhaar
steps.instruction: Confirm the fee shown on the official portal before payment, then pay and submit the request. Sahayi cannot predict the amount that will be charged, and submission does not guarantee approval.

steps.title: Save the service request number
steps.instruction: After successful submission, download the invoice and keep the SRN so you can check the request status on the official portal.

submission_channels.name: MyAadhaar portal
submission_channels.guidance: The address update request is completed on UIDAI's official MyAadhaar portal, not in Sahayi.

tracking_guidance.text: A successful online address update submission generates an SRN. Keep the downloaded invoice and use the official Check Aadhaar Update Status service.

limitations.text: Sahayi provides guidance only. It is not UIDAI or a government service and cannot authenticate you, submit an update, or track your request.
UIDAI verifies and validates submitted information and documents; submitting a request does not guarantee an address update.
